headline: At risk for extinction, protection for monarchs delayed until 2030 in a federal court settlement.
summary: The Western monarch population has been on verge of collapse for a few years now, which in part led to the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service in late 2024 to announce monarch butterflies would be considered threatened by December 2025.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
